subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this durable runtime, persistent schema, Gateway/CLI protocol, and environment-control surface as a supported beta3 core contract?
rationale: This is a new cross-cutting product and operator API, not a narrow repair; implementation correctness and green checks cannot authorize its permanent ownership, defaults, or support burden.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded core
options.body: Approve the direction while requiring a minimal permanent surface, removal or separation of unrelated changes, and complete upgrade and live-behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the RFC
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not promote it until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104246 receives an explicit maintainer architecture decision.

options.title: Decline the core contract
options.body: Close the stack if OpenClaw should not own this persistent durable-runtime and operator surface in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded core
recommendation.body: Approve the direction while requiring a minimal permanent surface, removal or separation of unrelated changes, and complete upgrade and live-behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows the broadest ownership across the affected Gateway, agent, protocol, and shared-state decision surfaces.
